stories.title: Flintshire drug deaths stay at highest level in more than a decade as health board says trend is a concern
stories.summary: Seventeen drug poisoning deaths were registered in Flintshire last year, the same as in 2024 and up from five in 2022, official figures show. Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board said the longer-term trend in Flintshire and across north Wales remains a significant concern. stories.title: Yellow fog warning for Flintshire from 6pm tonight until Tuesday morning
stories.summary: A yellow weather warning for fog is in place across Flintshire from 6pm today until 10am on Tuesday. The Met Office says fog will redevelop this evening, becoming dense at times overnight, with visibility reduced to less than 100 metres. It says this will likely lead to some delays to transport and difficult travelling conditions.

stories.title: Grid operator cancels call for extra power after Connah’s Quay steps up as wind output drops
stories.summary: Britain’s electricity system operator has cancelled a call for extra generation, after Connah’s Quay power station ran three of its four gas turbines at close to full output this morning. stories.title: Petition with 11,400 signatures demands full £550m for additional learning needs in Welsh schools
